content: dxf-parser (gdsestimating) is the dominant JS/TS DXF parsing library at ~670k npm downloads/month despite last publishing in 2021; entity coverage (LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, ELLIPSE, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, DIMENSION, SPLINE, 3DFACE) matches structural-drawing needs and excludes HATCH which is out of scope for mid-fidelity rendering. Actively maintained alternative dxf-json (TS-native, 50+ entity types) exists but has ~6k downloads/month and is pre-1.0/API-unstable.
